# crosswork_port_groups_rules (Resource)

This resource can manage the dynamic rule of a port group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_port_groups_rules" "example" {
  group_id = "16f9288d-ab96-4ea5-8593-94b30cbf00ee"
  name     = "cwtest-port-group"
  conditions = [
    {
      attribute = "name"
      operator  = "starts_with"
      value     = "Four"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `conditions` (Attributes List) The conditions in order; 10 at most (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions))
- `group_id` (String) Id of the port group that the rule fills; a group has at most one rule
- `name` (String) Name of the rule; set it to the name of the port group

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Required:

- `attribute` (String) Port attribute to test
  - Choices: `name`, `admin_status`, `oper_status`, `type`, `speed`
- `operator` (String) How the attribute is compared. `name` takes every string operator, `type`, `admin_status` and `oper_status` take `equals` and `not_equals`, and `speed` takes `equals`, `not_equals`, `greater_than`, `greater_than_or_equals`, `less_than` and `less_than_or_equals`. `matches` compares the whole name without regard to case, and `*` stands for any characters.
  - Choices: `equals`, `not_equals`, `matches`, `not_matches`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `starts_with`, `ends_with`, `blank`, `not_blank`, `greater_than`, `greater_than_or_equals`, `less_than`, `less_than_or_equals`

Optional:

- `logical_operator` (String) How the condition is joined to the one before it, `and` or `or`; not set on the first condition and required on the others. `and` binds tighter than `or`, so `1 and 2 or 3 and 4 and 5` reads as `(1 and 2) or (3 and 4 and 5)`
  - Choices: `and`, `or`
- `value` (String) Value to compare with, none for `blank` and `not_blank`. `admin_status` and `oper_status` take `UP` or `DOWN`, `type` takes one of the port types Crosswork lists, and `speed` takes a whole number with a unit and a space, as `100 Gbps` (units `bps`, `Kbps`, `Mbps`, `Gbps` and `Tbps`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_port_groups_rules.example "<id>"
```
